summary: Generate the Crossing asset build list and grid spec into docs/ from the room briefs

coordination.notes: Dan asked for a build list covering every Crossing asset plus a grid system for placing and filing pieces. Generated from data/art/out/geometric-room-briefs.json rather than hand-written, so the counts cannot drift from the data the way a hand-maintained doc would. Does not duplicate geometric-room-briefs-crossing.md, which is a per-place catalogue of individual room briefs; this is a synthesis by asset family plus the grid, and it is derived from the same single source. Documentation and tooling only - no Godot content, which is Codex's.
